title: Show HN: Minigraf – An embedded, bi-temporal graph database in Rust
summary: Minigraf is an embedded, self-contained bi-temporal graph database written in Rust that serves as a successor to an earlier temporal graph database project. It removes external database dependencies by providing its own storage, transaction, and query engines as a library crate that embeds directly into applications.
problem_solved: Provides a lightweight, embeddable graph database solution with full bi-temporal modeling capabilities without requiring external database infrastructure.
why_valuable: Enables developers to embed graph database functionality with temporal tracking directly into their applications, reducing system complexity and dependency overhead.
